    AFFORDABLE APARTMENTS FOR RENT IN THE
       CHINATOWN AND LOWER EAST SIDE
Stanton Norfolk Inc. is pleased to announce that applications are now being accepted for a limited number of
available re-rental apartments within a number of affordable housing developments in the Chinatown and
Lower East Side sections of Manhattan. These affordable housing developments received financing through one
or more grant and/or loan programs from New York City Housing Preservation and Development (HPD). Rent
levels and income requirements may vary amongst different buildings, but the following chart provides general
guidelines and ranges:

                                                                                  Household         Minimum Annual        Maximum Annual
     Unit Size              AMI                                Monthly Rent1

2

3

4 Minimum income listed may not apply to applicants with Section 8 or other qualifying rental subsidies.



Qualified applicants will be required to meet income guidelines and additional selection criteria.


    How Do You Apply?                                     To request an application by mail, send a self-addressed envelope with
                                                          postage to:
                                                          Chinatown Apartments c/o Stanton Norfolk Inc. PO Box 981, New York, NY
                                                          10002.

                                                          To apply online:
                                                          https://chinatown-
                                                          rentcafewebsite.securecafe.com/onlineleasing/chinatown/guestlogin.aspx

    When is the Deadline?                                 Applications are being accepted until available apartments are fully rented. A
                                                          waiting list will be created.

    What Happens After                                    Applications will be processed in chronological order, based on the date and
    You Submit an                                         time that they are received. If you appear to qualify based on the information
    Application?                                          provided on your application, you will be invited to an appointment of
                                                          eligibility to continue the process of determining your eligibility. You will be
                                                          asked to bring documents that verify your household size, identity of members
                                                          of your household, and your household income.

                                                          Once vacancies are filled, remaining qualifying applicants will be placed on the
                                                          waiting list to be processed for future vacancies.
